{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
data_clean = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_clean = data_clean.loc[data_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_baseline}")"}
